Game Overview

At its heart, Health Protection is a casual game about embark on a microbial adventure as a heroic bacteria in Health Protection. Begin your quest weak, but grow stronger by vanquishing smaller foes. Sharpen your skills in observation and strategy, choosing the right foes in thrilling battles to defend your microscopic world against invading threats.
